description: Fictional Quantumult X fixtures for the Nexitally node parser. Hosts, passwords, and UUIDs are placeholders. Never replace these with a live subscription export.

cases.name: happy-path-full-profile
cases.notes: Full fictional profile: mixed protocols, comments, traffic lines, a Premium placeholder, and one exact duplicate.

cases.name: mixed-protocols-keep-supported-drop-unknown
cases.notes: Keeps anytls, shadowsocks, vmess, vless, trojan, http, socks5. Drops ssr and wireguard.

cases.name: comments-and-blanks
cases.notes: Semicolon, hash, and slash-slash comments plus blank lines are ignored.

cases.name: duplicates-first-wins
cases.notes: Exact trimmed duplicates are removed. The first copy is kept.

cases.name: premium-and-traffic-excluded
cases.notes: Lines matching [Premium], Traffic, Expire, Reset, Days Left, 流量, 到期, 剩余, or 套餐 are dropped even when they look like servers.

cases.name: section-order-and-case
cases.notes: [SERVER_LOCAL] is matched case-insensitively. Earlier [policy] and later [filter_local] stay out of the result.

cases.name: crlf-and-bom
cases.notes: Stored as LF in git. The harness prepends a UTF-8 BOM and converts newlines to CRLF before parsing.

cases.name: server-local-until-eof
cases.notes: When [server_local] is the last section, every remaining non-excluded server line is kept.

cases.name: whitespace-around-equals
cases.notes: Protocol prefixes may have optional spaces before '='.
